notes.title: Work status and Discord
notes.content: [h2]Hi architects![/h2][p][/p][h3]Work status[/h3][p]We haven't written in a while, but that doesn't mean we're not working on the game. [/p][p]We have just finished all the core mechanics and are starting to work on content for the third and fourth tiers of employees.[/p][p][/p][p]Here you have all tiers quarters. Worker -> Technician -> Engineers -> Scientist (WIP name)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528773/e7d2773a8c1fb4581bb42053a637d7e62990c83d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Discord Server[/h3][p]In addition, we finally created a discord where we are going to share the progress of the work asking for your feedback. If you want to be part of the development, please join our [url="https://discord.gg/sm7X2wysk5"]Discord server[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi architects![/h2]

As we previously announced, we are pleased to announce that demo version of Astro Architect is available to be played right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3563960/Astro_Architect_Demo/

While the game downloads, check out the first trailer.

[previewyoutube=EKr0zu9Zf4Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
All your feedback will be appreciated and will have impact on how the final game looks and plays.

There's a special section in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3291440/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url] for telling us what you think, but feel free to create your own threads there.

There's also dedicated in game function to leave us feedback or report any bugs.

[h2]Music[/h2]
Music made for the demo was created by Wooden Pixel, you can check out more of his music [url=https://www.facebook.com/woodenpixel.music/]here[/url]


Your Frost Crown Studio
